name: Real-Time Chat App
description: A MERN-based chat application supporting real-time messaging using Socket.io. Includes user authentication, private/public chat rooms, and stores messages in MongoDB for persistent and secure communication between users.

name: Ai Code Manager
description: Developed a secure JavaScript online compiler that allows users to write, execute, and test code in real time. Integrated coding assistance features and file-saving functionality to improve productivity and streamline code management.

name: Task Manager
description: A secure and useful task manager app built with MERN technology where one can perform CRUD operations to create, delete and update task, also with search bart to search tasks

name: Ai Auditing App
description: Built an AI-powered auditing application that analyzes data records, detects anomalies, and generates intelligent audit reports. The platform automates verification processes, improves compliance tracking, and provides actionable insights for faster and more accurate decision-making.
